claims.claim: The module resets NumPy/Torch seeds, sets float32, and requests CUDA as the default device at import.
Task construction collects shapes, predicts solution shapes, constructs multitensor system, masks, problem tensor, and optional solution tensor from the supplied problem.
Query output shape prediction is controlled by in_out_same_size and all_out_same_size, otherwise maximum dimensions are used.
Known raw colors from support inputs/outputs and query inputs are sorted into the task color list, with black added.
Problem and mask tensors are moved to the current Torch default device; masks are converted to the default dtype.
The reconstruction loss grid-size branch uses in_out_same_size, all_out_same_size, and all_in_same_size.
Mask postprocessing uses task shapes to add large negative modifiers outside per-example max dimensions.
The forward path samples latent noise with torch.randn; an exact group action on RNG streams is not defined in source.
When dims[0] is set, multitensor tensors have an example axis whose length is task.n_examples.
Adam optimizer state is empty before the first optimizer step and is created by normal optimizer.step execution.

The source contains x/y and directional symmetry machinery, but a complete D4 whole-pipeline null requires explicit action on raw grid, shape, masks, directions, axes, trainable state, and inverse scoring.

j_classification_policy.reason: No D4 transform is labelled J_NULL_CANDIDATE without a source-backed full-pipeline action and CPU evidence.
